extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, industry stakeholders, licensees, and potential commenters on NRC rulemakings and notices
extracted.subtask_description: A machine-readable listing/collection of U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) Federal Register documents (notices, rules, proposed rules, and other agency actions) with abstracts, links, and publication metadata; used to identify actions that invite public comment, meetings, rulemakings, and procedural filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 30-day public comment period for Privacy Act system notice
rubrics_metrics.description: This system notice is subject to a 30- day public comment period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pursuant to the Privacy Act of 1974, the NRC proposes to revise System of Records NRC 16 to reflect issuance of a new rule establishing a new part for advanced reactors; the notice explicitly provides a 30-day window for public comment on the proposed revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: 30-day public scoping period for NEPA EIS
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRC is initiating a 30-day public scoping period to gather input on the scope of the EIS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under NEPA, the NRC will prepare an environmental impact statement for an Early Site Permit application and solicits public input during a 30-day scoping period to define the scope of issues and alternatives to be evaluated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for public comments and public meeting on License Termination Plan (LTP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRC is requesting public comments on CR3's LTP and will hold a public meeting to discuss the LTP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The LTP contains known radiological information for the site, planned demolition and decommissioning tasks, and final radiological surveys/data required for license termination; the NRC uses public comment and meetings to inform its review of LTP submissions and license amendment requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information collection renewal submitted to OMB (PRA notice/solicitation of comments)
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRC has recently submitted a request for renewal of an existing collection of information to the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As required by the Paperwork Reduction Act, the agency publishes notices when requesting OMB renewal of information collections (e.g., 'Safeguards on Nuclear Material, Implementation of US/IAEA Agreement' or 'NRC Form 748') to solicit public comment on the burden, necessity, and content of the collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of risk-informed, performance-based regulatory framework for microreactors
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rule would establish a risk-informed and performance-based regulatory framework for rapid licensing of new microreactors and other reactors with comparable risk profiles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The framework's objectives include providing flexible licensing pathways, reducing regulatory burden, enabling high-volume deployment, and ensuring that safety and security requirements remain commensurate with the potential hazards posed by these facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology-neutral, plant/site-parameter approach in Generic Environmental Impact Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Generic Environmental Impact Statement uses a technology-neutral framework and a set of plant and site parameters to determine which potential environmental impacts are common (appropriate for generic analysis) and which are unique (require project-specific analysis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rulemaking codifies the generic findings and revises guidance (e.g., Regulatory Guide 4.2, COL-ISG-030) to inform how environmental reviews for new reactor applications should distinguish generic vs. site-specific impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public notification of schedule/title changes for monthly notices of applications involving no significant hazards considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRC is notifying the public of its revised schedule and title change for Monthly Notices of Applications and Amendments to Facility Operating Licenses and Combined Licenses Involving No Significant Hazards Considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural notices inform stakeholders about publication schedules and administrative changes that affect how and when license amendment applications that claim no significant hazards considerations are announced to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural requirement for license transfer and conforming license amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRC issues orders approving direct and indirect transfers of construction permits/licenses and conforming license amendments after reviewing applications and supplements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: License transfer approvals are documented in Federal Register notices with details on parties, scope of transfer (direct/indirect), and any conforming amendments; interested parties can review notices to understand NRC's transfer determinations and any associated conditions or timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice and opportunity to comment/participate on subsequent license renewal and records of decision
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRC considers applications for subsequent renewed facility operating licenses and prepares records of decision that support license issuance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices of applications for subsequent license renewal are published to inform the public and provide opportunities to comment or participate in related proceedings and environmental reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicitation of qualified candidate nominations for advisory committee appointment
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRC seeks qualified candidates for appointment to the Advisory Committee on Reactor Safeguards (ACRS or Committee).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal Register notices requesting candidate nominations signal required qualifications and invite submissions from individuals or organizations; such notices typically describe the committee role, desired expertise, and nomination procedures (specific qualification criteria may be included in full notice text).
